verdict.rationale: Puzzle ships a dedicated 'AI Close' month-end feature and AI Close Agents for accountants, plus reconciliation (e.g., 3-min Stripe revenue reconciliation), cash/accrual books, and a 'reviewed by you before anything's final' human sign-off step, which together map to the close-checklist story. However there is no explicit evidence of a structured checklist UI tracking discrete accrual/reconciliation items with sign-off status per task. Missing for 10: an explicit checklist/task-tracking interface, accrual-specific automation detail, and independent verification of sign-off workflow.
